info.name: qTest Manager API Version 3.0 Test Cycle API

params.name: projectId
params.description: ID of the project

params.name: parentId
params.description: ID of the Release or Test Cycle which directly contains the Test Cycles you are retrieving. Input 0 (zero) to get Test Cycles directly under root

params.name: parentType
params.description: The artifact type of the parent folder. Valid values include release, test-cycle or root

params.name: expand
params.description: Specify expand=descendants to retrieve the Test Cycles' sub and grand-sub Cycles/Suites

params.name: tosca
params.description: tosca

params.name: page
params.description: Specify any page number to retrieve Test Cycles

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Specify any page size to retrieve Test Cycles. If a negative value is provided and no page number is specified, all Test Cycles will be retrieved.

items.docs: To retrieve Test Cycles which are located directly under root or a Release/Test Cycle

params.name: projectId
params.description: ID of the project

params.name: parentId
params.description:
ID of the Release or Test Cycle under which the newly created Test Cycle will be located. 

Use 0 (zero) to create the Test Cycle under the root

params.name: parentType
params.description: The artifact type of the parent folder. Valid values include release, test-cycle or root

items.docs: To create a Test Cycle qTest Manager version: 6+

params.name: projectId
params.description: ID of the project

params.name: testCycleId
params.description: ID of the Test Cycle which you want to retrieve.

params.name: expand
params.description: Specify expand=descendants to include its sub and grand-sub Test Cycles and Test Suites in the response

items.docs: To retrieve a Test Cycle qTest Manager version: 6+

params.name: projectId
params.description: ID of the project

params.name: testCycleId
params.description: ID of the Test Cycle which needs to be updated.

params.name: parentId
params.description: ID of a Release or parent Test Cycle which the updated Test Cycle will be moved to. Input 0 (zero) to move the Test Cycle to under root

params.name: parentType
params.description: The artifact type of the parent folder to which the Test Cycle will be moved to. Valid values include release, test-cycle or root

items.docs: To update a Test Cycle or move it to another container qTest Manager version: 6+

params.name: projectId
params.description: ID of the project

params.name: testCycleId
params.description: ID of the Test Cycle which needs to be deleted.

params.name: force
params.description: The Test Cycle can only be deleted if it contains no children. Specify force=true to delete the Test Cycle and its children

items.docs: To delete a Test Cycle qTest Manager version: 6+
